results.content: **COVID-19** (**coronavirus disease-2019**) is an infectious disease caused by **severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2** (**SARS-CoV-2**), a strain of coronavirus. The official name of the illness is COVID-19 (a shortening of COronaVIrus Disease-2019) 15 and it is caused by the "severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2" (SARS-CoV-2) 16,22,46. Children seem to be less seriously affected by this virus than adults, or indeed other closely-related coronaviruses 31,47,90 with large cohort studies reporting that 1-2% of symptomatic COVID-19 patients are children 59,90,91. During the COVID-19 pandemic, lateral flow tests of small samples from the upper respiratory tract have become widely used for detecting whether SARS-CoV-2 antigens are present or absent 235. * results.title: What is pattern recognition?
results.content: Pattern recognition is the process of detecting, identifying, and classifying regularities or structures in data so those regularities can be used for decision-making, prediction, or understanding. Pattern recognition is the process of detecting, identifying, and classifying regularities or structures in data so those regularities can be used for decision-making, prediction, or understanding. It is the branch of Machine Learning that focuses on the recognition of patterns and regularities in data. It is the branch of Machine Learning that focuses on the recognition of patterns and regularities in data. The supervised classification of input data in the pattern recognition method uses supervised learning algorithms that create classifiers based on training data from different object classes. *   Pattern recognition always learn from data. 5.   Neural Networks: Deep learning models for complex pattern recognition Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image analysis Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for sequential data. For example, in image recognition, the model can identify objects in photos by recognizing patterns in pixel arrangements.
